about_blocks.text: Gateway Recovery Centre is a unique facility that was created to serve the unique needs of military personnel, veterans, first responders, and healthcare professionals who are seeking mental health and addiction treatment. The staff at Gateway Recovery Centre is made up of professionals with multidisciplinary backgrounds, including physicians, schizophrenics, nurses, counselors, and coaches. All staff members share a general ethos of empathy and compassion, and are always aware of the perspective of each client. At Gateway Recovery Centre, a comprehensive approach is taken to treat a range of co-occurring mental health conditions, including anxiety, depression, and trauma, as well as alcoholism and behavioral addiction.

All staff members share a general ethos of empathy and compassion, and are always aware of the perspective of each client. At Gateway Recovery Centre, a comprehensive approach is taken to treat a range of co-occurring mental health conditions, including anxiety, depression, and trauma, as well as alcoholism and behavioral addiction.

about_blocks.text: Clients at Gateway Recovery Centre will engage in a range of different treatment methods in order to address their unique needs. Some of these approaches include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), educational groups, family counseling, adventure therapy, life skills training, mindfulness meditation, yoga, and other activities. The goal of this comprehensive approach is to empower clients to address their individual challenges and lead a healthy and fulfilling life.

about_blocks.text: At Gateway Recovery Centre, clients can expect to find a pleasant and comfortable environment that is designed to promote healing and tranquility. The facility is located just outside of Peterborough, Ontario, on 14 wooded acres, next to the Heron Landing Golf Course. The building itself is 22,000 square feet, and features a range of amenities that contribute to the client’s overall experience. These include a lounge with a fireplace, semi-private rooms, a fully-stocked gym, a game room, and walking trails. Gateway Recovery Centre provides a therapeutic, peaceful setting that promotes healing and recovery.

about_blocks.text: At Gateway Recovery Centre, we provide a range of personalized treatment programs to meet the unique needs of every individual. Our comprehensive programs include individual and group therapy, detoxification, mental health management, and relapse prevention strategies. In addition to these traditional treatment methods, we also offer alternative therapies such as art therapy, equine therapy, and outdoor activities to help clients find new and healthy ways to cope with their emotions and experiences.

about_blocks.text: Our experienced and compassionate staff understand that addiction and trauma are complex issues that require individualized care. They work closely with clients to develop customized treatment plans that address both the underlying causes of addiction and the physical and emotional symptoms of withdrawal. Our staff also provides ongoing support after treatment to help clients maintain their recovery and prevent relapse. At Gateway Recovery Centre, we are dedicated to helping individuals and their families overcome addiction and find a path to a fulfilling life in recovery.
